description: Sector notes from The 07:00 Brief, each with its sector, title, text and date. Five sectors: markets-commodities (Markets & Commodities), themes-ai-technology (AI & Technology), themes-energy-transition (Energy Transition), real-assets-energy (Energy) and geopolitics-core (Geopolitics). sectors narrows the set (all five by default); names outside the five are listed as unavailable. Without a date, the latest note in each sector; with date (YYYY-MM-DD), the notes published that day.
name: get_sector_notes
title: Get sector notes
